interactive.label: FRET / homoFRET
interactive.tooltip: Combined heteroFRET and homoFRET parameter calculator — convert between distance, efficiency, lifetime and rate.

interactive.label: FRET line
interactive.tooltip: Compute static, dynamic, WLC and mixture FRET lines for parameter ranges, ready to overlay on smFRET 2D histograms.

interactive.label: FCS diffusion
interactive.tooltip: Confocal-FCS diffusion/volume calculator — solve τ, D, rₕ, V_eff and concentration from one constraint.

interactive.label: RICS precision
interactive.tooltip: Predict how precisely a raster scan would measure a diffusion coefficient, and sweep the pixel dwell time to find the one that measures it best — from the intended settings, before acquiring.

interactive.label: Phasor plot
interactive.tooltip: Interactive phasor plot — universal semicircle with a reference-lifetime grid/ticks, a FRET trajectory and a two-component mixing line.

interactive.label: κ² distribution
interactive.tooltip: Orientation-factor distribution p(κ²) for FRET — wobbling-in-cone, diffusion-with-traps and isotropic models with apparent-distance error.

interactive.label: F-test / χ²-max
interactive.tooltip: Compare two nested model fits (confidence ↔ χ² threshold) and compute the χ²-max upper limit of a single fit at a confidence level.

interactive.label: FCS Saturation
interactive.tooltip: Numerical calculation of excitation saturation and effective volume expansion in FCS across arbitrary multi-state kinetic schemes (e.g. Cy5).

interactive.label: PSF calculator
interactive.tooltip: Compute a 3-D point-spread function and view it as a volume: vectorial Richards-Wolf, scalar Airy or Gaussian, with the polarization entering the objective pupil.

interactive.label: tau0
interactive.tooltip: Donor-only fluorescence lifetime (no acceptor).

interactive.label: R0
interactive.tooltip: Förster radius R0.

interactive.label: R
interactive.tooltip: Donor-acceptor distance. Any of distance, lifetime, efficiency or rate may be entered; the others are recomputed.

interactive.label: tau
interactive.tooltip: Donor lifetime in the presence of acceptor (D in DA). Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: E
interactive.tooltip: FRET efficiency. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: kFRET
interactive.tooltip: FRET rate constant. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

interactive.label: sigma
interactive.tooltip: Width of the donor-acceptor distance distribution.

interactive.label: χ distribution
interactive.tooltip: Use a 3D non-central chi distance distribution instead of a Gaussian. Distances are never Gaussian: a Gaussian assigns weight to negative / near-zero distances, while the chi distribution is non-negative and vanishes at contact (R=0).
